title: mentha × schultziana
intro: Mentha × schultziana, commonly known as the mint-leaved bergamot or bergamot mint, is a hybrid mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to ease digestive issues, reduce nausea and stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × schultziana include acting as a carminative, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting sedative and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, linalool, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
